text: Level three, question seven: two articles are sold at twelve hundred rupees each, one at a twenty percent profit and one at a twenty-five percent loss; find the overall loss percent. Question eight: two laptops are sold at forty-eight thousand rupees each, one at a twenty percent profit and one at a twenty percent loss; find the rupee loss. Question nine: two items are sold at four thousand nine hundred and fifty rupees each, one at a ten percent profit and one at a ten percent loss; use the rupee-loss formula, then verify with the cost prices.
